reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 editorial review of all 26 original questions: read complete German sentences, checked all four options for each, accepted keys, hints, bilingual feedback, adjective/adverb form and distinct scenarios. Corrected two sentences during review: idiomatic sich ehrenamtlich engagieren and unsupported legal-liability wording for eigenverantwortlich. Authored 13 source rows; deferred six for likely earlier CEFR levels or formal register, and marked elektronisch duplicate of legacy-0019's digital/electronic objective. Inherited English glosses for ehrenamtlich, eigenverantwortlich and emotional were corrected in report notes. No source example copied, including the long treaty example for endgültig. Structural CI is not independent German approval, rights certification or CEFR validation. Target reviews pending and publicationApproved=false.
